meta.title: Every Memory Begins With You
meta.subtitle: A love letter, told in time.
meta.endingMessage: No matter how far I grow, some part of me will always reach for you first.
meta.endingSubtext: Thank you for being the first place I ever felt safe.

sections.title: Your Little Baby
sections.subtitle: Where it all began
sections.quote: You held me before I knew what holding meant.

memories.caption: The very first days
memories.text: You always knew what I needed before I could ask. That quiet, wordless understanding — it's the thing I've searched for in every room I've ever walked into.

memories.caption: Learning to see the world
memories.text: Every color I encountered, I first saw through the wonder in your eyes. You didn't just show me the world — you made it beautiful before I could judge it.

memories.caption: Small hands, infinite trust
memories.text: I didn't understand what safety was. I just knew that wherever you were, I wasn't afraid of anything.

sections.title: Tiny Adventures
sections.subtitle: You made the small things feel enormous
sections.quote: With you, even ordinary days felt like they mattered.

memories.caption: Sunday mornings
memories.text: You had this gift for making the world slow down. A weekend morning could last forever when you were in it. I've been trying to recreate that feeling ever since.

memories.caption: The first real adventure
memories.text: You taught me that adventure doesn't need a destination. It just needs someone beside you who makes the road feel worth taking.

memories.caption: Your patience was endless
memories.text: I now understand what it costs to be patient. And I understand that you gave me everything you had, without ever keeping score.

sections.title: Growing Up
sections.subtitle: You watched me find myself
sections.quote: You let me become someone, even as you hoped I'd stay.

memories.caption: The age of questions
memories.text: I asked you everything. And even when you didn't have the answer, you never made me feel foolish for asking. That's rarer than most people know.

memories.caption: You saw me before I could
memories.text: Long before I understood who I was, you had already decided I was worth believing in. That belief became the ground I learned to stand on.

memories.caption: The quiet conversations
memories.text: We didn't always need words. Some of the most important things you ever told me, you said with a look. I still hear them.

sections.title: The Reel Phase
sections.subtitle: Life through a lens, still watched by you
sections.quote: You always made the frame feel larger than it was.

memories.caption: Behind the camera
memories.text: You watched every phase I moved through with the same eyes — curious, proud, and a little amused. You never made me feel like I had to explain myself.

memories.caption: The in-between moments
memories.text: The best ones were never the posed shots. They were the blurry, half-lit, unplanned ones — the moments no one meant to catch.

memories.caption: Still laughing, still us
memories.text: No matter what shifted in the world, our laughter stayed the same. The same pitch, the same timing, the same shared signal that said: we're okay.

sections.title: Becoming Myself
sections.subtitle: Finding my way, knowing you were there
sections.quote: I could only become myself because you never asked me to be anything else.

memories.caption: The distance that made us closer
memories.text: Growing up sometimes means growing away. But I realized: no matter how far I moved, I was still thinking in your voice.

memories.caption: Calling home
memories.text: There are certain conversations I keep returning to. Not because anything was resolved — but because the sound of your voice made everything feel less uncertain.

memories.caption: You never stopped showing up
memories.text: I've made mistakes you've never held against me. I've been difficult in ways you've never stopped loving me for. That is not something I take for granted.

sections.title: Still Your Child
sections.subtitle: Some things never change
sections.quote: However grown I become, there will always be a part of me that only you can reach.

memories.caption: Here, now, together
memories.text: You are still the first person I want to tell good news. Still the voice I need when things fall apart. Still home — no matter which city I'm in.

memories.caption: What I carry from you
memories.text: Your kindness lives in me. I see it in the way I listen, the way I worry, the way I love. Every good thing I've become has your fingerprints on it.

memories.caption: Thank you
memories.text: There are not enough words. There never will be. So I made this instead — a small, imperfect attempt to hold what I feel for you.
